document_contents.quote: The impugned proceedings were initiated on the erroneous assumption that the petitioner had wrongfully availed ITC by suppressing material facts and misreporting taxable value, which allegedly resulted in short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax and availing of ineligible ITC.
